messages:
sam: Pinging sec — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823 adds a sidecar to the onprem/dedicated runtime to mint short-lived tenant creds. Need sec signoff before we merge (aiming for Friday). Canaries planned. :eyes:

maria: Quick q — does this increase secret surface? where are tokens minted and stored? KMS/HSM in the path? :lock:

chen: Tokens are minted by auth-service in the same VPC via an internal endpoint. Sidecar requests a short-lived token (15m), stores in memory only, rotates on expiry. No long-term secrets on disk. We call KMS to unwrap tenant keys during onboarding.

olivia: Thanks — a few things we'll need before LGTM:
- threat model + short diagram (who can call the mint endpoint)
- logs: prove tokens are never emitted (add redaction unit test)
- egress policy for onprem clusters (allowlist only auth-service + kms endpoints)
- admin port on sidecar should be bound to localhost or mTLS-only

sam: noted. logs currently run through mask_token() in sidecar, but I'll add explicit redaction tests and a fuzz check. admin port is localhost-only by default.

sec-bot: Security scan: config check failed — sidecar admin port missing explicit TLS in deployment.yaml (low). See https://scans.internal/sec/scan-9087 :warning:

maria: Can we delay merge to Monday morning so privacy team can run a short review and I can validate the redaction tests? If we do canary, please do staging->canary->prod ramp.

chen: We can do Monday. I'll add a canary rollout config in PR (10% traffic for 2h -> 50% 4h -> full) and an automated smoke job that verifies /health and scans recent logs for token patterns.

olivia: Also add these checks to the rollout gating: no token patterns in logs, smoke return 200, egress allowlist applied. Add a checklist in PR body and tag sec L2. Once those pass, we can do a limited onprem sweep.

sam: Will update PR now with the checklist, threat-model diagram, and fix the TLS flag. Tagging @maria @olivia, holding merge until both give LGTM. Thanks! :thumbsup:
